svg.title: Superstore East region: $691,828 sales, $94,883 profit, 13.7% profit ratio; Ohio, Pennsylvania and Nova Scotia lose money.
svg.desc: Executive profitability dashboard for the East region, orders from January 2023 to December 2026. Sales total $691,828 with $94,883 profit, a 13.7% profit ratio, an average discount of 14.34% and 11,159 items sold. Most states and provinces are profitable in blue, while Ohio, Pennsylvania and Nova Scotia appear in orange with negative profit ratios.
